title: 第一卷 第2章 抱着她进酒店
content_zh:
饶是在夜场混了半年，这种接触童喻还是觉得手发烫，立刻拿开。

    男人却按住她的手，眼尾上扬，目光冷冽又灼烧着童喻。

    她的脸有点发烫。

    想把手收回来，他又抓得紧。

    耳边响起了意味深长的轻笑声。

    霍放这才松开她。

    她赶紧坐好，调整呼吸，控制着快要失控的情绪。

    “今天二少回国，我们得好好敬他一杯。”宋源举杯。

    其他人都朝霍放举起了杯子。

    霍放长腿随意交叠，左手臂搭在童喻身后的沙发上，另一只手放在腿上，把他们的谄媚都如数尽收。

    宋源专门安排了陪酒的小姐，见霍放提起酒杯没动，使了个眼色。

    陪酒小姐姐见状便准备去接霍放的酒杯，为他挡酒。

    手还没碰到，霍放压了一下酒杯，随即把酒杯递到童喻嘴边。

    “我胃不舒服，你帮我喝。”

    童喻没怎么喝过酒，更没陪过酒。

    今天，算是第一回。

    她刚才就想了很多，既然他没有拆穿她，那她就借着这个机会把他们的关系坐实了。

    只要还想在这里混，她就不能惹恼了霍放，甚至还要哄着他。

    童喻笑着接过酒，眼波流转，说不尽的风情，“好呀。只是，你知道我酒量差，一会儿喝醉了，你可要照顾我。”

    刚才被他当面抓现行是慌了，这会儿算是稳住了。

    不管他出于什么原因不拆穿她，她得让这里的人知道，她就是他的女人，还是他喜欢的女人。

    “放心。不会不管你。”霍放饶有兴趣地看着她。

    心态比想象中要好，都敢顺杆子往上爬了。

    其他人见状，笑得格外暧昧。

    他们想着，尽管是以前爬过床，时隔半年又遇上，多喝点酒助兴也挺好。

    高纯度的白兰地一开始让童喻有点难咽，没喝过这种酒。

    喝多了两杯，喉咙适应了这感觉，倒也没那么难。

    霍放坐在一旁抽着烟，看着女人一口一杯，豪爽潇洒，倒真有几分他女人该有的样子。

    童喻喝得双颊泛红，眸光水润，一直来者不拒。

    酒量再好的人这样喝，也会醉。

    霍放灭了烟，站起来走过去一把夺过童喻手上的酒杯重重放下。

    握住童喻的手腕拽着就出去了，丝毫不管其他人。

    童喻脑子昏昏沉沉，被他拉着脚步踉踉跄跄，几次都撞在他的肩膀上。

    一股冷风袭来，她忍不住打了个寒战，手臂起了鸡皮疙瘩。

    “你带我去哪里……”
content_en:
Even though he had been hanging out in nightclubs for half a year, Tong Yu still felt his hands were hot after being exposed to this kind of contact, so he immediately took it away.

    But the man held her hand, his eyes raised, his eyes cold and burning at Tong Yu.

    Her face felt a little hot.

    I wanted to take my hand back, but he held it tight again.

    A meaningful chuckle rang in my ears.

    Huo Fang then let go of her.

    She quickly sat down, adjusted her breathing, and controlled her emotions that were about to get out of control.

    "Today the second young master returns home, we have to toast him." Song Yuan raised his glass.

    Everyone else raised their glasses towards Huo Fang.

    Huo Fang's long legs were crossed casually, his left arm was placed on the sofa behind Tong Yu, and his other hand was placed on his leg, absorbing all their flattery.

    Song Yuan specially arranged for a young lady to accompany him. Seeing that Huo Fang did not move the wine glass, he winked.

    When the hostess saw this, she was ready to take Huo Fang's wine glass and stop him from drinking.

    Before his hands touched it, Huo Fang pressed the wine glass and then handed it to Tong Yu's mouth.

    "I feel sick to my stomach, please help me drink."

    Tong Yu never drank much, let alone drank with him.

    Today is the first time.

    She had thought a lot just now. Since he didn't expose her, she would take this opportunity to solidify their relationship.

    As long as she still wanted to hang out here, she couldn't offend Huo Fang, and even had to coax him.

    Tong Yu took the wine with a smile, his eyes moved with indescribable charm, "Okay. But, you know that I have a bad ability to drink. I will get drunk in a while, so you have to take care of me."

    I was panicking when I was caught in front of him just now, but now I have stabilized myself.

    No matter what reason he had for not exposing her, she had to let people here know that she was his woman and the woman he liked.

    "Don't worry. I won't ignore you." Huo Fang looked at her with interest.

    My mentality is better than I imagined, and I dare to climb up the pole.

    When the others saw this, they smiled particularly ambiguously.

    They thought that even though they had climbed into bed before and they met again after half a year, it would be good to drink more wine to cheer them up.

    The high-purity brandy made Tong Yu a little hard to swallow at first. He had never drank this kind of wine.

    After drinking two glasses too much, my throat got used to the feeling, so it wasn't that difficult.

    Huo Fang sat aside and smoked a cigarette, watching the woman take a sip, bold and unrestrained, which was exactly what his woman should be like.

    Tong Yu's cheeks turned red from drinking, his eyes were moist, and he always refused to come.

    No matter how good a drinker you are, you will still get drunk if you drink like this.

    Huo Fang put out his cigarette, stood up, walked over, grabbed the wine glass from Tong Yu's hand, and put it down heavily.

    He grabbed Tong Yu's wrist and pulled him out, not caring about anyone else.

    Tong Yu's mind was groggy, and he staggered as he pulled her forward, bumping into his shoulder several times.

    A gust of cold wind hit her, and she couldn't help shivering, and goosebumps appeared on her arms.

    "Where are you taking me..."
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 2 Carrying her into the hotel
